Meaning: Post-collection audit of all twelve retained clean runs. Only world frames are grouped by generation for diagnosis; no release gate denominator is changed. Worker render/encode/decode maxima can come from different workers and are not additive. Worker critical span includes start spread; recorded QPC spans include descheduling and transport. Unattributed elapsed time includes input copying before decode timer, indexed/encoded publication, timer/write overhead and scheduling, not pure pixel-copy cost. OutputMs means synchronous call duration for Strips and asynchronous completion observation for AsyncBatch, not equivalent host blocking. Sixteen workers currently publish 16*64000 indexed bytes per frame even when no host pixel read is requested; final image and explicit captures still require these pixels. No speedup or causal bottleneck is established by this audit.
